summary: NatWest Group filed a 6-K furnishing London Stock Exchange announcements of daily open-market purchases under its existing buyback, executed by UBS AG, London Branch under instructions dated 16 February 2026. Purchases on 2 November 2026 totaled 6,878,870 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average of roughly 587.6p across LSE, CHIX and BATE, with 4,237,185 shares on 3 November averaging about 584.5p. The programme is now complete: 121,932,783 shares repurchased at a 615.09p VWAP for total consideration of £749,999,998.96. Repurchased shares will be cancelled; treasury stands at 177,875,932 shares and 7,900,091,837 remain in issue. Watch for buyback pace, capital return cadence and any replacement programme.
